༄༅/ /rnga thug rten 'dzugs las mthun kun 'grub bzhugs so/ //

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnga thug rten 'dzugs las mthun kun 'grub bzhugs so// /

ya mā ri na mo/ rnga thug rten 'dzugs bya bar spro na/ khang thog shar ngos su lha rten dpe'u kha bad sogs bkod pa legs par byas pa'i steng du shug pa sogs/ sngon chad las sogs ma song ba'i shing yo 'khyog 'bu zos med pa rtsa rtse ma log pa/ rtse mo gri lcags las byas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ me ris spras pa/ de'i 'og tu 'brong la sogs pa'i rnga ma dkar ser dmar sngo nag gi chun po sna tshogs pa dang*/ dar dkar po sogs kyi 'phur lces brgyan pa/ de'i 'og tu ras dkar po'i ba dan gong ba sngon po/ 'og rgyag ser po/ lce bu dmar po sogs byas la/ gnam sa bar gsum mtshon pa byas pa'i rnga ma'i thad thug shing gi bang ngam/ logs kyi steng 'og bar gsum du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i sngags dang*/ bris sku la sogs par char chu rlung sogs kyis 'tshe ba med pa ca ga byas shing gong 'og ma log pa bzhugs/ sman dang phye mar spos la sogs pas bdug /rdo rje rnam 'joms sogs kyi khrus nas phyung la/ mdun du mchod pa sman raka phye mar sogs bshams/ bgegs bskrad/ bsangs sbyangs/ hūm̐ */ thug chen gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus chos thams cad// 'od gsal stong 'byams mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang*// bh+rūṃ las rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i// gzhal med khang chen brtsegs pa'i phyi rol du// rdo rje'i ra gur ye shes me ri 'bar// phyi nang steng 'og 'dod yon gyis gtams pa'i// steng gi cha la bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// mchog gsum yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs rnams bzhugs// bar gyi cha la ye shes chos skyong ba'i// srung ma dam can tshogs rnams sprin ltar gtibs| |'og gi cha la snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs// yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas mtsho ltar gang*// kun gyi gnas gsum yi ge dang mtshon zhing*| |zhes dang*/ thug snying sngar ltar btsugs pa yin na/ sngon nas bskyed bstims bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha// srung ma dam can rgya tsho'i tshogs rnams kun| |sku mdog zhal phyag rgyan rdzogs 'khor bcas rnams// gdod nas gnas pa slar yang yongs su gyur// zhes bskyed/

hoḥ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// dam can chos skyong dregs pa yul gyi lha// gzhi bdag tshogs bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa'i// rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams ni// sngon gyi smon lam thugs rje rmad byung ba// bdag cag rnal 'byor skyong dang 'gro ba'i don// dpag med mdzad phyir so so'i sprul 'khor bcas| |'dir gshegs rten la gnyis su med par bzhugs// zhes gsol ba btab/ hoḥ rang bzhin dag pa so so'i gnas mchog nas// rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// snang srid dregs pa yul lha gzhi bdag bcas// de ring spyan 'dren gnas 'dir myur gshegs shig /badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ hūm̐ */ sna tshogs chu 'dzin mkha' la gtibs 'dra ba'i// rnga thug brjid ldan rin chen gzhal yas khang*// rang rang mthun pa'i gnas mchog rab yangs par// dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐ */ dus gsum bde gshegs bla ma yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs// rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs rnams la// sgo gsum dang bas 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dzaḥhoḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma dam can tshogs// snang srid dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa la// thugs kyi dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod pa'i sprin// yon chab me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo sman raka gtor ma dang*// spyan gzigs longs spyod 'dod yon sna tshogs dang*// rang rang dgyes skong mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha' bskangs te 'bul// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/

nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba ling+ta/ kā ma bi shā kā sha pa ri pū ra ṇa sarba pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ bstod par 'os pa rtsa gsum zhi khro dang*// srung ma dam can dregs byed yul gyi lha// gzhi bdag bcas par rnal 'byor dad pa'i blos// sna tshogs bstod pa'i sprin gyis dgyes gyur cig /ces bstod/ hūm̐ */ de ring ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dus/ /khyed rnams mnyes pa'i pho brang rten 'dzugs so// lha shing dkar po drang la ldem pa ni| |dpag bsam ljon pa nyid kyang skyengs byed pa// tsan+dan spos dkar mkhan shug bsang la sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i dris byugs nam mkhar snyegs// de 'dra'i lha shing de ring rten du 'dzugs| |dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i gri rgod lcags// rtse gsum 'bar bas dug gsum rtsad nas gcod// dgra bgegs snying khrag dron mo'i ngar btab la// de 'dra'i dpal ldan de ring rten du 'dzugs// rtse mor byin za 'jig dus ltar 'bar ba// nam mkha'i mthong snyegs lha min g.yul ngor zlog /me yi tsha tshas nyon mongs dgra bgegs sreg /de 'dra'i sreg za de ring rten du 'dzugs// char sprin nag po rlung gis bskyod 'dra ba'i// gar zhog 'brong dang lha 'bri zhol chen gyi// spu sdug ma nyams phung por spungs pa 'di// rab 'jigs ji bzhin brjid ldan nam mkha' khengs// de 'dra'i thug chen de ring rten du 'dzugs// dbang po'i gnam ru mkha' la snang ba ltar// sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan du ma'i tshogs// rlung gis bskyod pas khams gsum mdzes pa 'phrog /de 'dra'i cod pan de ring rten du 'dzugs/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i mdangs ldan kā shi'i ras/ /gnam sa bar snang gsum gyi gong gsham dang*// 'phur lce ldan pa'i ba dan srid rtser 'phyo// stong gsum yud kyis 'gengs pa'i lhab lhub rgyan// de 'dra'i ru dar de ring rten du 'dzugs// kye/

me ri smug nag sku yi rten// sku yi rigs kyi srung ma rnams// sku yi rten 'dir bzhugs nas kyang*// lus kyi nad gdon zhi bar mdzod// gnam lcags ral gri gsung gi rten// gsung gi rigs kyi srung ma rnams// gsu+ung gi rten 'dir bzhugs nas kyang*// ngag gi nyes pa zhi bar mdzod// rnga thug che brjid thugs kyi rten// thugs kyi rigs kyi srung ma rnams// thugs kyi rten 'dir rtag bzhugs nas// yid kyi nyes tshogs zhi bar mdzod// lha shing dkar po yon tan rten// yon tan rigs kyi srung ma rnams// yon tan rten 'dir rtag bzhugs nas// nor rdzas god chag zhi bar mdzod// ru dar mdzes pa phrin las rten// phrin las rigs kyi srung ma rnams// phrin las rten 'dir rtag bzhugs nas// bsam don bar chad zhi bar mdzod| |kyai/ de ring sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las rten mchog dam pa 'dir// rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dang*// mchog gsum yi dam zhi khro dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang*// dam can chos skyong bka' sdod bcas// snang srid dregs pa yul lha dang*// gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bskang ngo gsol lo thugs rje can// nyams chag ma lus 'dir bskangs nas// nyams sgrib ma lus byang nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dpal be'u// rab tu dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /bdag cag yon mchod mi nor la// lo gcig deng sang phan chod la// sang phod da tsam tshun chod du// nad gdon dgra bgegs mi 'byung zhing*// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*// nang mi nor rdzas rab rgyas shing*// sgo'i rkang bzhi 'phel ba dang*// 'bras drug lo tog smin pa dang*// bsam don thams cad 'grub par mdzod// ces rten 'dzugs/ de rjes rten 'brel snying po dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs shis brjod dang bcas me tog 'thor/ rang gi srung ma gang yin gyi mnga' gsol dang*/

bskang bshags sogs bya/ rten cing 'brel 'byung phyi nang gsang gsum gnad// ji bzhin rtogs na rten 'brel 'di tsam yang*// gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis 'grub pa'i grogs// phul du byung ngo gshis sam babs kyi gshis// rang gshis babs kyi gnas lugs gdeng med pa// rim bzhin sdom gsum la sogs rnam mang po// gcig tu ma nges gzung 'dzin sta gon 'di// don gnyis 'bras bu lhun gyis 'grub dka' bas// de phyir 'dir rtogs rten 'brel tsam du bris// zhes rnga thug rten 'dzugs dpal ldan rga los dpal ma hā kā lār mdzad pa spyi khyab tu kha spom zhing tshig sbros legs su bsdebs pa 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me khyi zla ba lnga pa'i yar tshes brgyad la rtse ba gzhis kar mgyogs par bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
